title: Census PR5718-shape helper splits on the PR5907 word: none remain without a mid-word correction (no new κ)
body:
**Scoped finite certificate; no new κ.** Package `research/p104-pr5718-shape-split-census`, base `19fdb086e`. The selected record is unchanged.

## Result

Matarener's #5994 (`research/p104-helper-split-exhaustion`) excludes PR5599-type helper splits on the PR5907 word. Its first open question asks whether a split of the kind in flyingviper's #5718 remains: different input and output bases, with an output correction. This package decides the scalar part of that question exactly over Q.

The test covers the PR5718 shape. A group helper `p` retires at a strictly intermediate chart. A new independent helper takes over its continuation (unit injection `b = e_p`). The input functional may use the group, U-initial roles, or any role initial at the empty frame (PR5718's rule, main inputs included). Output normalisation is allowed on roles whose final chart is V. For every group, intermediate chart, cut after an event touching that chart, and group helper at the chart, the census checks three things: a pure prefix with `a_p ≠ 0`, no z-leak of `d = S e_p` to roles not final at V, and the pairing `a·b = c·d' ≠ 0`.

| Word | Input rule | Evaluations | Leak | Pairing fails | Witnesses |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| PR5713 source (calibration) | group + U-initial | 8,579 | 3,817 | 2 | **7** |
| PR5713 source (calibration) | + empty-frame roles | 8,579 | 3,817 | 2 | **7** |
| PR5907 | group + U-initial | 8,913 | 4,202 | 4 | **0** |
| PR5907 | + empty-frame roles | 8,913 | 4,206 | 4 | **0** |

- **Calibration:** on the PR5713 source word, the census recovers PR5718's own split: cut after 14330, chart 602, helper 708, ranks (2, 7). All 7 witnesses are on that chart and helper.
- **PR5907:** no class passes. Any further PR5718-type split there must cancel a z-leak with a mid-word correction. 425 classes leak to exactly one role. They are the nearest candidates and are listed per pivot in `RESULT.json`.
- PR5718's split is itself a boundary-relaxation witness of the #5994 census on its source word. So #5994's boundary exclusion already covers PR5718-shape splits on PR5907 whose defect stays on V-final roles. This package calibrates that link and locates the leaks.

Claim type: finite certificate of a scalar necessary condition on two fixed words. It is not a construction, an invoice or a complete multiplication theorem.

## Evidence and reproduction

Interpreter: CPython 3.12 (`~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12` locally), standard library only.

```sh
python3.12 -B research/p104-pr5718-shape-split-census/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-pr5718-shape-split-census
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-pr5718-shape-split-census --check-source-history
```

Local results: `PASS_P104_PR5718_SHAPE_SPLIT_CENSUS`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=completed` (34 s wall, 6 s CPU on a loaded machine; 3.6 s unloaded), and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES` with source history. The verifier authenticates the PR5907 word and the PR5713 word inside `research/p104-two-boundary-helper-split/inputs/pr5713-source.tar`. It also runs six synthetic controls of the pairing decision and compares `RESULT.json` byte for byte.

## Limitations

- Only the z-part of the split is tested. The non-z part of the normalisation, native maps, owned lifetimes, caller, compiler and outer checks are not checked.
- Only unit injection on one group helper is covered, as in PR5718. Injection along a combination of several fields is not covered.
- Mid-word corrections (`r += q·new` at a later meeting with a leaked role) are not modelled; they are the open route. An exact Fraction implementation of that relaxation took more than ten minutes per word and was not run to completion. It is not in the package.

## Open next questions

- Can a mid-word correction close the z-leak of one of the 425 PR5907 classes that leak to exactly one role? First step: list the later meetings of the pivot's chart with the leaked role, then test whether `S_τ e_r` reaches the leaked coordinate. Blocker: fast exact span maintenance.
- The four leak-free PR5907 classes (chart 549, helper 173, cuts 15974–15988) fail only `a_p = d_p c_p`. Does an input role outside the empty-frame rule make that solvable?

## Related open work

- #5994 (Matarener): PR5599-type census on PR5907. This package answers its first open question for the PR5718 shape. The two censuses test different conditions (general injection versus unit injection on one helper), so their numbers are not compared.
- #6030 (DreamingOfClouds): a newer conditional word (helper 470 rung removal). This census was not run on it.
- This account's PRs opened since the CLAIM (#6037, #6038, #6039, #6041) study connector chains, conjugate-pair targets, Q8 shear identities and paired-stage loss; none studies P104 helper splits.
- #5975, #5960 (Matarener): other work on the PR5907 word (event compression, a replay audit). Neither studies PR5718-type splits.
